notes: Primary score is the unweighted mean hidden measured_ddg of the scored final panel.
invalid_raw_value is the placeholder reported when a submission is invalid. Lower is better here, so it must stay far worse than any achievable mean; never use 0, which would read as a good result.
The default scored panel is prospective: unmeasured recommendations. Already-measured final picks remain a validity contract because they can be chosen by sorting returned values.
scored_panels may be set to ["prospective"], ["validated"], or ["validated", "prospective"]. Changing it changes the scientific quantity.
Round CSVs, plate maps, ledgers and the report are required files and may be logged; they do not have to replay the locked validation requests, and they do not enter the primary number.
